newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel cut to outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel cut to outperform.

text.p: Morgan Stanley said it downgraded Intel Corp to outperfrom from strong buy.
-- Earlier on Friday, Intel said revenues and net income for its fiscal second quarter will fall below expectations due to weaker-than-projected demand, particularly in Europe.
-- Analysts had expected Intel to earn $2.16 a share in the second quarter, according to First Call.
-- Intel said revenue for the period is expected to drop five to 10 percent below the first quarter's $6.4 billion. Second quarter gross margin is forecast below the 64 percent of the first quarter.
-- Intel dropped sharply in pre-open activity, to about about 145-1/2, down from its closing price of 163-49/64.
